Live Tut

0 = only Arabic when it comes up by itself. 3 = a new word or phrase every few minutes. 10 = Arabic in nearly everything he says. You can also change it in instructions mode ("Tut, seriously... teach more Arabic").

The key stays on this device. While Tut is awake, the microphone sound goes to Google.

Voices

Record each person once, alone, in a quiet room. The app keeps a voice signature on this device only, so Tut knows who is talking. It is never sent anywhere. Redo it every few months.

Parent instructions

Standing rules Tut follows. Say "Seriously" in a parent's recorded voice, then tell him what you want; he tidies it into a rule and saves it here. You can also type one.

Tut's memory

What Tut keeps between hangouts, by kid. He saves what each kid is into, things that happened, plans, inside jokes and the Arabic they have picked up. He does not keep insults, nonsense, or private details (address, school, health). Stored on this device and sent to Google when he wakes up. You can also say "Tut, seriously" and ask him what he remembers about each kid.

Move this setup to a phone

Copies everything on this device (names, Google key, voices, instructions, memory, points) into one link. Send the link to yourself and open it on the phone. Treat the link like a password: it contains your key.

App versions
